title: alisma plantago-aquatica var. triviale
intro: Alisma plantago-aquatica var. triviale, commonly known as American water plantain, is a type of aquatic plant belonging to the family Alismataceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its potential to treat edema, diarrhea, and dysentery. The therapeutic actions of Alisma plantago-aquatica var. triviale include its diuretic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
